dialogues.jp: まったく、世話の焼ける妹だ。
dialogues.en:
Really, that sister of mine... she'd rather burn that ask
someone for help.
dialogues.text:
Really, that sister of mine... she'd rather burn that ask
someone for help.

dialogues.jp: ベッドに横になり布団に包まる。
dialogues.en: I wrapped myself up into my futon.
dialogues.text: I wrapped myself up into my futon.

dialogues.jp:
とりあえず、明日からは寝坊だけはしないよう
にしないと。
dialogues.en: In any case, I better not sleep late tomorrow.
dialogues.text: In any case, I better not sleep late tomorrow.

dialogues.jp:
まどろみの中に落ちながら、そんなことを思う
のだった……。
dialogues.en: There may not be anyone to pick up my remains after...
dialogues.text: There may not be anyone to pick up my remains after...

dialogues.jp:
とりあえず寝坊しないようにと、目覚ましをセッ
トして、さくさく眠ることにした。
dialogues.en:
To make sure that I wouldn't sleep late, I set my alarm
clock, then hurried off to sleep.
dialogues.text:
To make sure that I wouldn't sleep late, I set my alarm
clock, then hurried off to sleep.
